text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of computers to do tasks that normally require human intelligence, such as understanding language or making decisions. One important part of AI is machine learning, where computers learn from data instead of following fixed instructions. Deep learning is a more advanced form of machine learning that uses large neural networks to solve complex problems. Today, AI is part of our daily lives. We use it when we ask voice assistants questions, get movie recommendations, unlock phones with our faces, or receive suggestions while shopping online. AI is changing the way we live and work.
